item.title: Haotong Li replaces Jake Knapp at Arnold Palmer Invitational after late withdrawal
item.description: Jake Knapp withdrew from the 2026 Arnold Palmer Invitational hours before the tournament was supposed to begin in Orlando. Haotong Li replaced him in the 72-player signature event field.

item.title: Stories and memories of the late Lou Holtz
item.description: Famed football coach, motivational speaker and, yes, golfer Lou Holtz died Wednesday. The "Golf Central" team shares stories and memories.

item.title: Beach time! John Daly II plans to rest, enjoy Puerto Rico after first PGA Tour round
item.description: It didn't take John Daly II long to find his footing on the PGA Tour. The University of Arkansas senior went viral during the opening round of the Puerto Rico Open after he chipped in for birdie on the 16th hole at Grand Reserve Golf Club.

item.title: Daniel Berger fires 9-under 63 to lead Arnold Palmer Invitational
item.description: Daniel Berger jumped out to a big, first-round lead early at Bay Hill that no player could match Thursday at Bay Hill.

item.title: Arnold Palmer Invitational 2026: Tee times, pairings, how to watch Round 2
item.description: Tee times, pairings and how to watch the second round of the PGA Tour's signature event, the Arnold Palmer Invitational.

item.title: Justin Thomas' return spoiled with bogey-filled opening round at API
item.description: The last time the golf world saw Justin Thomas compete was during the 2025 Ryder Cup at Bethpage Black. Thomas, playing his first tournament since back surgery in November, shot an opening round 79 at Bay Hill.

item.title: Chandler Blanchet leads with John Daly II under par in PGA Tour debut in Puerto Rico
item.description: Chandler Blancet leads the way after the opening round of the Puerto Rico Open, where kids of all ranges are grabbing headlines.

item.title: New driver in bag, Scheffler a little better this first round
item.description: Scottie Scheffler wasn't great Thursday at Bay Hill but he was better than in recent opening rounds. Check out highlights from Round 1 of the 2026 Arnold Palmer Invitational and insight from "Golf Central."

item.title: PGA Tour highlights 2026: Puerto Rico Open, Round 1
item.description: Chandler Blanchet shot an 8-under 64 Thursday and leads at Grand Reserve Golf Club after 18 holes. John Daly II made his Tour debut, finishing with a 2-unde 70 thanks to a spectacular chip-in for birdie on the 16th hole. The University of Arkansas senior spoke to media after the opening round in Rio Grande, Puerto Rico.

item.title: PGA Tour highlights 2026: Arnold Palmer Invitational, Round 1
item.description: Daniel Berger jumped out to an early lead with a 9-under 63 at the Bay Hill Club Thursday, and held on in the clubhouse despite superb efforts from Collin Morikawa and Ludvig Aberg. Scottie Scheffler and Rory McIlroy, the two-top ranked players in the world, also provided their fair share of highlights during the Arnold Palmer Invitational's opening round.
